# AGENT GUIDELINES

## ALWAYS — mandatory

- ALWAYS prepend this exact comment block to EVERY code block you create or modify:

```c
// AI generated by: <tool/model>
// Prompt: "<copy the exact user prompt here>"
// Changes: <brief explanation of what was changed>
```

- ALWAYS do this even for one-line edits. If you touch a human-written function,
  add the block above the changed lines.

## STOP — never do this

- NEVER write or edit documentation prose/diagrams for `dokumentace.pdf` or `/docs`.
- NEVER design grammar, LL table, lexer automaton, or precedence table.
- NEVER generate `symtable` / `bst` internals. You may only call the API.
- NEVER add third-party C libraries (test frameworks for tests only).
- NEVER let the compiler use network, spawn processes, or create/modify files.
